record_type_quote: This study is an exact replication of an experiment investigating the impacts of website design on users’ ability to use a website and their opinion of the website (Galletta et al., 2006).

targets.evidence_quote: This study is an exact replication of an experiment investigating the impacts of website design on users’ ability to use a website and their opinion of the website (Galletta et al., 2006).
targets.outcome_quote: The replication confirms the importance of website design features, specifically delay, breadth, and familiarity on users’ ability to use and form an opinion of a website. However, the replication did not confirm the main finding, that it is the interplay of these three variables, i.e., cognitive cost, that predict performance and attitude.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit agreement and disagreement with the target findings; main interaction finding unconfirmed, but the title does not focus specifically on that interaction.
